introduction: Missouri’s Working Family Tax Credit is claimed with the state income-tax return and depends on federal EITC eligibility.
description: Missouri’s Working Family Tax Credit is claimed with the state income-tax return and depends on federal EITC eligibility.

sections.who: A same-year federal EITC, eligible filing status, remaining state liability and investment-income conditions apply.
sections.get: The credit is nonrefundable and cannot carry forward. Revenue lists 20% of federal EITC for tax year 2024 onward.
sections.docs:
• Federal return and EITC information.
  • Dependent names, Social Security numbers and birth dates.
  • Correct-year Missouri forms.
sections.apply:
1. Complete federal taxes

    Establish the same-year federal EITC.

  2. Prepare MO-WFTC

    Follow Revenue’s credit instructions.

  3. Attach required records

    Include MO-WFTC and a copy of the federal return with MO-1040.
sections.after: Keep copies. Missing the federal return can disallow the credit.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Missouri WFTC rules. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Must I attach the federal return?
